minimum_visual_signature: Upright white cards, graphic upper field and short white caption band; exact bold PANTONE header and English object-linked subtitles. Use source colors and include restrained stripes/geometric motifs rather than all-solid blocks. Asymmetric source-specific placement and natural partial person occlusion. No clothing recoloring.
